sources.snippet: Qwen3-0.6B Introduction Qwen3 is the latest large language model in the Qwen series, offering both dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures. It features seamless switching between thinking and non-thinking modes, enhanced reasoning and instruction-following abilities, superior human preference alignment for engaging conversations, strong agent capabilities for tool integration, and ...
